 MILWAUKEE, WISCONSIN - OCTOBER 22: Catcher William Contreras #24 of the Milwaukee Brewers speaks to media at a press conference during a workout day prior to game on of the 2026 World Series between the Tampa Bay Rays and the Milwaukee Brewers at American Family Field on October 22, 2026 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. (Photo by Stacy Revere/Getty Images) 
 The 2026 World Series is finally upon the Major League Baseball world, and for the first time since 1982, the Milwaukee Brewers will have a shot to take home the Fall Classic hardware for the first time in franchise history.
 A huge part of the Brewers’ current run to the final series on the MLB calendar has been star catcher William Contreras .
 William Contreras was traded to the Milwaukee Brewers before the 2023 season, and he’s been an everyday player for the Brew Crew since, and yes, William has a brother in MLB. Willson Contreras , first baseman for the Boston Red Sox , is directly related to William Contreras.

 More MLB on Heavy: New York Yankees Will Pay 36-Year-Old Player $25 Million Next Season 
 More on the Contreras Family
 Getty MILWAUKEE, WISCONSIN – OCTOBER 12: William Contreras #24 of the Milwaukee Brewers rounds the bases after hitting a home run in the fifth inning against the Los Angeles Dodgers in game two of the National League Championship Series at American Family Field on October 12, 2026 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. (Photo by John Fisher/Getty Images) 
 William and Willson Contreras are both veteran MLB players from Puerto Cabello, Venezuela.
 William and Willson Contreras’ parents are William Contreras Sr., and Olga Contreras.
 They have a very strong and powerful story about their attempts to relocate to the United States for a better life for the family, and Contreras Sr. and Olga Contreras were eventually able to land in Orlando, Florida, in 2019 to watch both of their son’s professional baseball journeys.
 Safe to say it’s turned out pretty good!
 William Contreras is a 3X All-Star, 2X Silver Slugger, and already has a World Series title to his name with the 2021 Atlanta Braves .
 In 2026, William Contreras batted .270 with 18 home runs, 153 hits, and 94 RBI. William is approximately six years younger than his older brother, Willson.
 More MLB on Heavy: Toronto Blue Jays All-Star Owed $17 Million in 2027 by Current Team 
 Taking a Look at Willson Contreras
 Getty NEW YORK, NEW YORK – SEPTEMBER 30: Willson Contreras #40 of the Boston Red Sox hits a single against the New York Yankees during the first inning in game two of the American League Wild Card Series at Yankee Stadium on September 30, 2026 in the Bronx borough of New York City. (Photo by Elsa/Getty Images) 
 Willson Contreras also knows what it feels like to win a World Series, as he did with the Chicago Cubs in 2016. He’s been very vocal and supportive of his brother William during both of their playing careers.
 Willson has played 11 seasons in MLB and is a 4X All-Star.
 He’s clubbed 199 home runs in his career, with a lifetime OPS+ of 122 over 1208 total games played.
 This 2026 World Series should be extremely exciting, and if the Brewers are to capture the series victory, William Contreras will likely play a large role behind the plate and with the bat in his hands.
